content_of_post_to_comment: I think half of faith is just refusing to go numb. Staying soft in a world that would honestly be easier to get through with your heart turned off. That's the work. Every day, that's the work.
comment: There’s an interesting tension here: staying soft requires boundaries too. A heart that remains open without discernment can be wounded into numbness. Maybe the work is protecting tenderness, not just preserving it.
